name: Shaped Reverb
description: A reverb whose tail follows a drawn shape instead of dying away: it can hold level and stop dead, rise backwards into a cut, swell and fade, or pulse.

params.name: Shape
params.description: The outline the reverb follows. Gate holds its level and stops dead. Reverse grows louder and cuts off. Bloom swells in and fades away. Fall drops in a straight line. Pulse breathes in three waves.

params.name: Time
params.description: How long the shape lasts from the note to its end. Short settings are a burst behind the note; long ones are a slow cloud.

params.name: Density
params.description: How many reflections make up the shape and how blurred they are. Low settings are a handful of separate echoes; high settings are a smooth wash.

params.name: Pre-delay
params.description: A gap of silence between the note and the start of the shape, which keeps the note clear of the reverb.

params.name: Colour
params.description: Changes the tone along the shape. Below the centre the reverb gets darker as it goes on; above the centre it starts dark and opens up towards the end.

params.name: High Cut
params.description: Takes the top off the whole reverb. Lower settings are darker and sit further back.

params.name: Low Cut
params.description: Takes the bottom out of the reverb so low notes do not turn to mud. Higher settings are thinner and lighter.

params.name: Modulation
params.description: Slow movement inside the reverb. A little keeps held notes from sounding fixed; more adds a gentle detuned shimmer.

params.name: Repeat
params.description: Plays the shape again and again, each time quieter, darker and more blurred. High settings pulse for a long time.

params.name: Tail
params.description: Adds an ordinary fading reverb behind the shape, so the end is not dead silence. Higher settings are louder and ring for longer; at zero the shape ends in nothing.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the reverb spreads between the speakers. At zero it is mono; fully up the two sides are unrelated.

params.name: Mix
params.description: Balance between the dry signal and the reverb. Fully up is the reverb alone.
